name: Progenitor's Icon
oracle_text:
As this artifact enters, choose a creature type.
{T}: Add one mana of any color.
{T}: The next spell of the chosen type you cast this turn can be cast as though it had flash.
blocked_sentences: {T}: The next spell of the chosen type you cast this turn can be cast as though it had flash

needs.what: a one-shot flash permission consumed by the next matching spell cast this turn, whose spell filter can read the creature type chosen as the source entered (subtype = the permanent's chosen creature type)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_flash_permission takes only duration, player and card 'types' (validated against KNOWN_TYPES, so no subtypes and no reference to a chosen type), and the FlashPermission it writes lasts for the whole duration rather than being used up by the next spell cast; the cast_as_though_flash static is continuous, not a single-use grant from an activated ability
